macos.rationale: Desktop installers for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (x64 and ARM64) and Linux (x64 and ARM64; AppImage, deb, rpm). Minimum OS versions are not stated in the sources read. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Self-built iOS client.

windows.rationale: Desktop installers for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (x64 and ARM64) and Linux (x64 and ARM64; AppImage, deb, rpm). Minimum OS versions are not stated in the sources read. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Self-built iOS client.

linux.rationale: Desktop installers for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (x64 and ARM64) and Linux (x64 and ARM64; AppImage, deb, rpm). Minimum OS versions are not stated in the sources read. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Self-built iOS client.

web-client.rationale: Web app at multica.ai with email-code or Google sign-in; same account and data as Desktop. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Self-built iOS client.

cli.rationale: multica CLI for macOS, Linux and Windows (install script or Homebrew) manages issues, agents, skills, runtimes and the daemon. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Self-built iOS client.

local.rationale: Desktop starts a built-in daemon, or the CLI daemon runs on the laptop. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Pinned Multica source.

own-server.rationale: The CLI install and setup commands run on a remote or headless computer over SSH; runs execute there. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Pinned Multica source.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The scoped first-party runtime offering explicitly waitlists the vendor-hosted runtime; connected-computer execution and the third-party Qoder bridge are separate.

worktree.rationale: Repository checkouts use per-task git worktrees from cached bare clones; local directories can use per-run worktrees. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

container.rationale: The official security guide documents running the daemon inside an operator-configured container. Multica does not provision or enforce that boundary itself.

vm.rationale: The security guide documents an operator-provided VM as an isolation setup. This is not a Multica-managed VM service.

parallel-runs.rationale: A daemon runs up to 20 runs at once by default; each agent up to 6; the effective limit is the smaller. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

coordinator.rationale: Squads provide product-owned delegation: an agent leader receives the issue, @-mentions member agents, records an evaluation, and is re-triggered by replies; members can run on different tools. No provider-native subagent claims were evaluated. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

issue-tracking.rationale: Native issues include creation, editing, comments, priority, labels, assignment, search, filters, projects, five views, backlog parking and explicit dispatch with separate retained runs. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Cron schedules with IANA time zone, multiple schedules per autopilot, run-now. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

multiplayer.rationale: Any member who can run an agent can comment, mention or reply; a reply to a running agent can be added, queued or restart it. Two-account steering not tested. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

roles.rationale: Owner, admin and member with a permission matrix. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

pr-workflow.rationale: PRs are opened by the agent using the GitHub CLI on the user's computer (tutorial); the GitHub App does not create PRs. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop.

license.rationale: The repository-root LICENSE (Multica License: Apache-2.0 plus Part I conditions) at commit 8db6cfe is the only license file read. Part I requires keeping the Multica logo, product name and attribution in the Multica interface unless a branding waiver is granted. No client-specific license was found in the sources read. Scope: Pinned Multica source.

self-hosting.rationale: Docker Compose and Kubernetes (Helm) deployment of web, API and Postgres. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Pinned Multica source.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and ANALYTICS_DISABLED=true on self-hosted servers. Scope: Multica Cloud/web/desktop, Pinned Multica source.

claude-code.rationale: The official runtime table names this coding harness and its launch command. The installed tool and account belong to the user. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to multica:ACC-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

antigravity.rationale: The released runtime probes and invokes the installed agy executable, with binary-path and model overrides.

byo-subscription.rationale: Multica invokes the coding tool already installed and signed in on the execution machine, retaining that tool’s native login. Plan eligibility depends on the tool.

ios.rationale: The native iOS client is available as a source build installed with Xcode. No public App Store download is implied; free signing expires after seven days.

android.rationale: The first-party mobile guide states there is no Android client yet; only a source-built iOS client exists. Scope: Multica clients.

mobile-web.rationale: The browser issue interface adapts its comment composer for phone-sized viewports.

free-tier.rationale: The complete self-hosted application is free for use within one organization under the stated source-available license. Model and machine charges remain separate.

starting-price.rationale: Internal self-hosted use has no recurring Multica license fee. Hosting for outside organizations requires a separate commercial license.

free-plan.rationale: Internal self-hosting free; commercial licence and paid cloud separate.

no-paid-plan.rationale: A paid Pro workspace subscription has monthly/yearly billing and prices per human seat; this is not a wholly free ADE offering. Actual Cloud prices remain undisclosed.

subscription.rationale: A paid Pro workspace subscription has monthly/yearly billing and prices per human seat; this is not a wholly free ADE offering. Actual Cloud prices remain undisclosed.

per-seat.rationale: A paid Pro workspace subscription has monthly/yearly billing and prices per human seat; this is not a wholly free ADE offering. Actual Cloud prices remain undisclosed.

byok.rationale: The user installs and authenticates coding tools on the execution computer and pays their provider separately for model usage.

paid-from.rationale: The changelog mentions subscribing to a Pro plan; no price is published and the site offers Contact sales.

review-ui.rationale: The documented review workflow shows PR metadata and review-agent comments but sends code-diff review to GitHub, rather than displaying proposed code changes in Multica.

laptop-independent.rationale: A daemon on a separate user-operated server executes the run while Cloud or self-hosted Multica coordinates it. That server must stay online.
